tracker: supervision ByteTrack (ephemeral ids used only to avoid double counting; never stored)

line_config.description: Public sample road-traffic clip, location not in the pilot area; used only to demonstrate the counting method. Fixed elevated camera looking down a two-carriageway road; all visible traffic travels toward the camera. Counting line: horizontal at 58% of frame height (y = 418 of 720), from the left edge to 58% of the width, spanning both carriageways and the left footpath.

line.note: Directed left to right; moving downward in the image (toward the camera) = inbound, upward (away) = outbound. 'inbound' here only means toward the camera, not toward any stand or city.

line_config.clip_label: Public sample road-traffic clip (original title: 4K Road traffic video for object detection and tracking). Actual resolution 1280x720 at 30 fps.

clip.original_filename: 4K Road traffic video for object detection and tracking - free download now!.mp4

privacy.note: Upper part of person boxes is blurred in the annotated video. This is not reliable face anonymisation: missed detections are not blurred.

limitations: COCO has no auto-rickshaw class; autos may be detected as car/two_wheeler or missed. Counts are not validated unless a spot check is recorded.
